schema:
CREATE TABLE lists (
  list_comments,
  list_cover_image_url,
  list_creation_timestamp_utc,
  list_description,
  list_first_image_url,
  list_followers,
  list_id,
  list_movie_number,
  list_second_image_url,
  list_third_image_url,
  list_title,
  list_update_timestamp_utc,
  list_url,
  user_id
);

CREATE TABLE lists_users (
  list_creation_date_utc,
  list_id,
  list_update_date_utc,
  user_avatar_image_url,
  user_cover_image_url,
  user_eligible_for_trial,
  user_has_payment_method,
  user_id,
  user_subscriber,
  user_trialist
);

CREATE TABLE movies (
  director_id,
  director_name,
  director_url,
  movie_id,
  movie_image_url,
  movie_popularity,
  movie_release_year,
  movie_title,
  movie_title_language,
  movie_url
);

CREATE TABLE ratings (
  critic,
  critic_comments,
  critic_likes,
  movie_id,
  rating_id,
  rating_score,
  rating_timestamp_utc,
  rating_url,
  user_eligible_for_trial,
  user_has_payment_method,
  user_id,
  user_subscriber,
  user_trialist
);

CREATE TABLE ratings_users (
  rating_date_utc,
  user_avatar_image_url,
  user_cover_image_url,
  user_eligible_for_trial,
  user_has_payment_method,
  user_id,
  user_subscriber,
  user_trialist
);
